caption:
An AI built a cinematic trailer for the Iliad, and the result is hard to separate from real Hollywood footage.

Grok Imagine is the model behind this. The entire trailer was generated from prompts: no cameras, no actors, no set. Every frame is synthetic.

Production teams used to spend months and millions making trailers like this. Grok Imagine generates the same quality from a text prompt.
